prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home wait_info changes are consistently helpful, winning 6 out of 12 tests.
Adoption redesigns are generally helpful, winning 3 out of 5 tests.
Choose_path updates (copy, layout, redesign) show no clear positive effect and frequently result in neutral or negative outcomes.
Finish hints, sign-in notifications, and sign-in redesigns show no positive effect, frequently causing negative impacts or early test stops.
Adoption hints, home redesigns, finish layouts, finish new flows, sign-in copy, and sign-in incentives show no clear effect across multiple tests.
Predictions were systematically too low for large winning changes and too high for changes with no clear effect or negative outcomes; single-test categories remain thin evidence.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Audio Status Notification Display: Display live ambient status audio and completion notification indicators on the waiting screen so users know exactly when their pet is ready for the desktop. (why: Home stage has high mean wait time (2336s) and wait_info changes on home are historically the most consistent winning strategy (6/12 test wins).)
1: [finish, new_screen] Home Intro Desktop Companion Setup Flow Screen: Add a new setup screen 'new_companion_setup' during the finish step to explicitly guide users on how to dock, minimize, and summon their new pet. (why: Support mail highlights 3 emails specifically complaining about confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and 3 about pets not showing up on desktop.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Download Progress & System Status Display: Show a detailed multi-stage asset download progress bar with time estimate and background status on the waiting screen. (why: Home median time is 201s and mean is 2336s. Providing explicit asset loading and system status reduces drop-off during long renders.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Two Column Trait Showcase Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend selection view into a two-column overview layout contrasting companion archetypes and personality stats side by side. (why: Adoption screen redesigns have proven highly effective in previous iterations, and adoption is a key step (83.2% conversion, 89s median).)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Asset Preview Wait Info: Add an animated preview component and live render status ticker to the waiting screen to engage users while waiting for pet generation. (why: Wait info modifications during the waiting step consistently win test cycles and keep users informed during high wait times (2336s mean).)
5: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Command Practice Screen: Insert a new interactive practice screen 'new_command_practice' into the finish flow where users test hiding, moving, and calling their pet. (why: Support messages show recurring confusion after onboarding about how to control, hide, or talk to pets, as well as desktop visibility issues.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Interactive Tip Carousel Wait Info: Add an interactive tip carousel on the waiting screen explaining desktop pet controls and account backup features while rendering. (why: Addresses post-onboarding confusion (how to control/hide pet) and account loss concerns (8 support emails about missing/reset pets) during natural waiting time.)
